triggerPolicy.terminationProof: Each trigger permanently removes one of the 30 normal pairs; removed pairs never return.

effects.cardTextZh: 没有额外效果，收下这篮水果。
resolution: Move the resolved pair to its owner's public harvest area.

effects.cardTextZh: 随机打乱你自己的全部手牌顺序；你不能决定新顺序。
resolution: Server creates a uniformly random permutation of the effect owner's ordered hand.
A protected-card marker follows its card.
With zero or one card, resolve with no state change.

effects.cardTextZh: 本回合交接时，跳过下一名本应行动的玩家；多个效果累加。
resolution: Increment skipCount by one.
Consume all skipCount entries only after the effect queue is empty.

effects.cardTextZh: 查看一名其他未安全玩家的全部手牌及其左右顺序；查看后牌序不变。
effects.privateResult: Only the effect owner receives the target's ordered card identities.
resolution: Return a private snapshot of every card identity and its current left-to-right slot.
Include the protected card and protection flag.
Do not shuffle, reverse, or otherwise reorder the target hand afterward.

effects.cardTextZh: 选 1 张可用手牌送给一人，再从其原有可用手牌中盲抽 1 张；收到的牌各自任意插入。
resolution: Owner locks one available outgoing card face down.
Target exposes stable backs for only the available cards it owned before this effect.
Owner blindly selects one return card.
Both cards transfer simultaneously; each recipient selects an insertion slot.
After both insertions, perform one simultaneous pair sweep and append every effect to the queue.

effects.cardTextZh: 随机找一名手牌数与你相同的玩家；双方各选 ⌈H ÷ 2⌉ 张同时交换，收到后任意插入。
resolution: Read H after removing the trigger pair and after every earlier queued effect.
Uniformly choose one legal equal-count target; if none exists or H is zero, resolve with no exchange.
Both players secretly lock exactly ceil(H / 2) available cards before either choice is revealed.
Transfer both batches simultaneously; recipients may order the batch and choose any insertion slots.
After both insertions, perform one simultaneous pair sweep and append every effect to the queue.

effects.cardTextZh: 保护自己 1 张手牌，使其不能被正常暗抽或甜蜜分享，直到下一次有人从你处正常暗抽。
resolution: End any previous shield owned by this player.
Mark one chosen hand card without moving its slot.
Exclude it from normal draws, sweet-share outgoing cards, sweet-share returns, and half-exchange selections.
End protection after the next normal draw from this owner, when the card pairs, when it is forced through market conveyor, or when it becomes the sole hand card.

effects.cardTextZh: 将自己 1 张手牌移到任意新位置。
resolution: Move exactly one existing card to one selected insertion slot; keep all other cards' relative order.

effects.cardTextZh: 立即从你顺时针方向最近的可抽玩家处再正常暗抽 1 张，放到最右侧。
resolution: The effect owner performs one normal hidden draw without becoming current player.
Append the received card to the rightmost hand slot.
Sweep a new pair and append its effect to the queue.

effects.cardTextZh: 所有仍有手牌的未安全玩家同时把最左侧牌传给顺时针下一人；收到后任意插入。
resolution: If fewer than two eligible players remain, resolve with no transfer.
Every eligible player removes the current leftmost card simultaneously and passes it clockwise in the eligible ring.
A shield on a forced leftmost card ends when the card leaves.
Each recipient selects any insertion slot; then perform one simultaneous pair sweep and enqueue all effects.

oldMaidRule.cardTextZh: 永不配对。最终持有一张或多张老鳖的玩家落败。
